description: Record the user's explicit approval of the exact persisted manifest revision and content hash. Never call before the user has seen and approved that manifest; approval alone does not start a run.

expectedFlowRevision.description: Flow revision from the current session — stale values are rejected.

expectedManifestRevision.description: The exact manifest revision the user approved.

manifestContentHash.description: Content hash of the approved manifest, from update_asset_set_plan's response — proves the user approved this exact draft.

planNodeId.description: The asset_set plan node's id in the graph.

sessionId.description: Persisted flow session id (flow_session_…) from create_asset_flow or list_asset_flows.

name: approve_asset_set_plan
